Name: Wooden Picture Frames-REDUX
Author: klatuprism
Description:
[size=3]Updated[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10705] Wooden Picture Frame[/url]  by aedenthorn to be 1.6 compatible.

[b]Permissions Disclaimer:[/b]
Aedenthorn has retired from SDV modding and has removed all restrictions on permissions concerning their mods.
This announcement can be found [url=https://discord.com/channels/137344473976799233/156109690059751424/1194051284177801307]here [/url]in the Stardew Valley Modding Discord server.
[/size]

This is a content pack for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27147]Custom Picture Frames-REDUX[/url]. It requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].

It adds four new wall-hanging furniture:

[list]
[*]Wooden 1x2 Frame
[*]Wooden 2x2 Frame
[*]Wooden 3x2 Frame
[*]Wooden 3x3 Frame
[/list]
To set a picture in a frame, see the documentation for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27147]Custom Picture Frames-REDUX[/url]﻿.

You can buy the frames at Robin's store for 100-400 each.
